title: Deleting a server group through Terraform
aliases: server group destroy updates unrelated segments

prose.text: The provider cleans up references to a server group before it deletes it, and the application segment part of that cleanup changed between versions.
The rest of the cleanup, including that its failures are logged and ignored, is in [[zpa.terraform.delete-paths]].

checks.do: Which provider version applied the destroy, since the application segment cleanup differs between v4.4.4 and the pin.
Whether application segments still reference the deleted group afterwards; the shared cleanup behavior is in the delete-paths subject.

segment-cleanup-updated-every-segment-at.statement: At v4.4.4 the provider's cleanup before a server group delete rewrote the server group list of every application segment and updated each one, whether or not it referenced the deleted group.

quotes: if appServerGroup.ID == id { continue } ids = append(ids, servergroup.ServerGroup{ID: appServerGroup.ID}) } app.ServerGroups = ids

upstream.note: The pinned code carries a guard whose comment describes this symptom; the issue thread itself was not read.

segment-cleanup-updates-only-referencing.statement: At the pinned version the same cleanup updates only application segments that referenced the deleted server group.

quotes: // Only update application segments that actually referenced the server
